[D5]

[Verse 1]
[D5]I lie screaming Re-
membrance of the past [B5/F#][D5][A#5/F]E-
[D5]motions betray me below
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [C5/G]
[D5]Adversity my
martyrdom [B5/F#][D5][A#5/F]
[D5]Rancid breakdown bethothed
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [C5/G]

[Bridge]
[D#5]Memories of [F#5]passion over-
[F5]whelming me [G#5]Cor-
[D#5]rupted love [F#5]is displaced
[F5][G#5]The
[D#5]insect [F#5]onset, death
[F5]does not liberate [G#5]Deadfall,
[D#5]her [F#5]final embrace
[F5]  [G#5]

[Intro Riff]
[D5]
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [A#5/F]
[D5]
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [C5/G]

[Verse 2]
[D5]Forced to watch her decompose
Putrefy, it fills [B5/F#]my [D5]nose [A#5/F]
[D5]Tears in anguish I grieve
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [C5/G]
[D5]Smell scent upon her shoulder
Festering, begins [B5/F#]to [A#5/F][D5]moulder
[D5]Maggots are conceived
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [C5/G]

[Bridge]
[D#5]My delusions now [F#5]torment me
[F5]Agonising the [G#5]misery
[D#5]At this point of death [F#5]we do not
[F5]part [G#5]
[D#5]Visualise my [F#5]partner's corpse
[F5]I have but love no [G#5]remorse
[D#5]In the final [F#5]deaththroes of my heart
[F5]  [G#5]

[Solo]
[D5]
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [A#5/F]
[D5]

[D5]Look her in the eye Re-
pulsive way thrive [B5/F#][D5][A#5/F]
[D5]Death's spawn I feed
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [C5/G]
[D5]Choking on the fumes In this
heat infested room [B5/F#][D5][A#5/F]
[D5]My heart it bleeds
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [C5/G]

[Verse 4]
[D5]Lying trapped, my mind is free Hal-
lucination, [D5][B5/F#]fantasies [A#5/F]
[D5]Relieve the life from when we
met [B5/F#][D5][C5/G]
[D5]Now I'm in her death's restrain Hor-
rific visions through [B5/F#]my [D5]brain [A#5/F]
[D5]Her rigor mortis starts to set
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [C5/G]

[Bridge]
[D#5]Memories of [F#5]passion over-
[F5]whelming me [G#5]Cor-
[D#5]rupted love [F#5]is displaced
[F5][G#5]The
[D#5]insect [F#5]onset, death
[F5]does not liberate [G#5]Deadfall,
[D#5]her [F#5]final embrace
[F5]  [G#5]
[D#5]With her corruption I'm [F#5]paralysed
[F5]Optic fluids pour from [G#5]the eyes
[D#5]Foul stench of [F#5]decay makes me retch
[F5]  [G#5]
[D#5]Sweetly smiling from [F#5]her jaws Death
[F5]opens wide it's [G#5]sharpened claws
[D#5]This death's [F#5]erotic, how I letch
[F5]  [D5]  [B5/F#]  [D5]  [A#5/F]
[D5]  [B5/F#]  [D5]  [A#5/F]  [D5]  [B5/F#]  [D5]  [A#5/F]
[D5]  [G#5]  [D5]  [G5]

[D#5]
[E5]
[D#5]
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [A#5/F]
[D#5]
[E5]
[D#5]
[D5]  [B5/F#]  [D5]  [A#5/F]
[D#5]I thank god I'm an
atheist [E5]Pro-
[D#5]long my anguish
subtract bliss [D5][B5/F#][D5][A#5/F]

[D5]

[D5]And as she rots This
nightmare never stops [B5/F#][D5][A#5/F]
[D5]I long for peace
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [C5/G]
[D5]In the end Death
is my lonely friend [B5/F#][D5][A#5/F]
[D5]I crave release
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [C5/G]

[Verse 6]
[D5]I lie screaming
Smothering in love [B5/F#][D5][A#5/F]Now
[D5]at the Reaper's call
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [C5/G]
[D5]A life that's seen A-
doration [B5/F#][D5][A#5/F]
[D5]Trapped in her deadfall
[B5/F#]  [D5]  [C5/G]

[Outro]
[D#5]Memories of [F#5]passion over-
[F5]whelming me [G#5]Cor-
